---
name: Feature request / Usulan fitur
about: Suggest an idea for Flavenz / Usulkan ide untuk Flavenz
title: "[feat] "
labels:
  - enhancement
---

**Problem / Masalah**
What limitation are you hitting? / Keterbatasan apa yang kamu hadapi?

**Proposed solution / Usulan solusi**
What should happen instead? / Seharusnya jadi seperti apa?

**Device context (if tuning related) / Konteks device (kalau terkait tuning)**
- Device / SoC / GPU:
- Why existing profiles/presets don't cover it / Kenapa profile/preset existing tidak mencakup:

**Scope check / Cek lingkup**
- [ ] This is within Flavenz scope (sysfs tuning / WuWa INI configs / Termux
      tooling) — not a game ToS bypass / Ini dalam lingkup Flavenz, bukan bypass ToS game
